entry.title: New: RES26-256 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT TO THE CITY OF ONE HIGH-BACK TRADITIONAL BENCH, PREPARATIONS OF THE GROUNDS, AND A BRONZE PLAQUE WITH AN INSCRIPTION TO READ "DONATED BY THE FAMILY OF DAVID JAMES TILLINGHAST-LEWMAN," VALUED AT $2,718.74, FROM BETH TILLINGHAST TO BE PLACED AT KAPIʻOLANI REGIONAL PARK.

Latest action: Introduced.
